name: control-arm memory JSON-leak isolation layer
title: Control-arm memory JSON-leak isolation on top of B-ab8d experiment-arm gate
description: Add a control-arm isolation layer on top of main's B-ab8d experiment-arm render gate: redact the runtime memory pack at every JSON/file serialization surface the render gate leaves host-readable (done_closure/final_response_check/host_dispatch/handoff/manifest/health), gate final_response_check (the 8th RuntimeConsumer) through surfaceRuntimeMemoryPack, gate parallel_dispatch experience injection, and add two corpus-export commands to the memoryRetrieval block. Keyed on main's resolveExperimentArm (LATTICE_* env). Measurement stays lossless via the experience_pack_surfaced event; treatment and no-experiment output byte-identical.
